title: Build the loop-run list and detail projection surfaces from one helper and prove the hosted readback against the real BFF routes

hosted_incident.before_behaviour: control_loops/service.py list_loop_runs built surface with projection_schema_version and projection_mode, but get_loop_run constructed a handwritten detail surface omitting both fields. Readback failed with bff_loop_surface_invalid.
hosted_incident.after_behaviour: control_loops/service.py shares _postgres_projection_surface helper across list_loop_runs and get_loop_run. Both paths provide identical source, projection_schema_version, projection_mode, controller, and formal truth rule.

ac1_shared_surface_helper.detail: list_loop_runs and get_loop_run build surfaces via _postgres_projection_surface, ensuring parity in schema version, mode, controller, and truth rule.

ac2_e2e_contract_test.detail: Contract tests in services/trade_journey/test_hosted_bff_readback.py run readback against real FastAPI routes with stub projection reader and dev-login operator, and verify drift failure when projection_schema_version is omitted.

ac3_readback_not_weakened.detail: services/trade_journey/hosted_bff_readback.py was unchanged; contract verification rules remain strict.

ac4_hosted_failure_and_missing_fields_re.detail: Hosted deploy run 37647100516 documented with artifact, error code, and missing fields projection_schema_version and projection_mode.

ac5_net_prod_budget_and_no_compression.detail: Production code diff is net -5 lines (-26, +21 in control_loops/service.py), strictly within the 40 line budget with standard clean formatting.

ac6_hosted_track_external_wait.detail: Hosted track: the next automatic dev pair release passes the authenticated public BFF readback step of the canonical paper lifecycle probe or its evidence names the next failing gate; recorded as external_wait until then.
